description: WMS_RP_AFIS - Referenzstationspunkte is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Landesamt für Vermessung und Geobasisinformation (LVermGeo) Rheinland-Pfalz. National representation of the fixed points (geodetic base grid points, altitude fixed points, gravity fixed points and reference station points) of the uniform integrated geodetic spatial reference of the surveying administrations of the Federal Republic of Germany. The presentation is based on the signature catalogue AFIS-Web-SK. Coverage: Landesamt für Vermessung und Geobasisinformation (LVermGeo) Rheinland-Pfalz. Its keywords include infoMapAccessService, AdV, AFIS, Referenzstationspunkte, Geobasisdaten, Amtliches Festpunktinformationssystem. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2026-06-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open.
